sloka: एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६० ।।।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।ājaghānānilasutaṁ talenorasi vīryavān ।। 6.59.60 ।।।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.
